\begin{restated}{Definition}{def:B1-PSAGA}{B1}{0}{$P$-SAGA: SAGA in the metric of $P$}
Fix $\gamma>0$, $\theta_0\in\R^d$ and memory vectors $z_i^{(0)}\in\R^d$, $i=1,\dots,n$. At iteration
$t\ge1$, draw $i(t)$ uniformly in $\{1,\dots,n\}$, independently of the past, and set
\begin{align*}
g_t&:=f'_{i(t)}(\theta_{t-1})+\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n z_i^{(t-1)}-z_{i(t)}^{(t-1)},\tag{\ref*{eq:B1-gt}}\\
\theta_t&:=\argmin_{\theta\in\R^d}\Big\{\inner{g_t}{\theta}
+\frac1{2\gamma}(\theta-\theta_{t-1})^\top P(\theta-\theta_{t-1})\Big\},\tag{\ref*{eq:B1-argmin}}\\
z_{i(t)}^{(t)}&:=f'_{i(t)}(\theta_{t-1}),\qquad z_j^{(t)}:=z_j^{(t-1)}\quad(j\neq i(t)).\tag{\ref*{eq:B1-memory}}
\end{align*}
The memory update \eqref{eq:B1-memory} is the one of SAGA \cite{defazio2014saga}; only the step
\eqref{eq:B1-argmin} depends on $P$.
\end{restated}
